h1: How do water and sewer connection or upgrade permits work in Newton, MA?
title: Newton Water and Sewer Connections: Applications, Estimates and Permits
description: Learn how Newton processes new water service and which Engineering approvals apply to trenching and utility installation.
short_answer: For a new water service, Newton requires the property owner to submit a water-service application to the Utilities Division. The City then prepares a cost estimate for its portion of the work. The private utility contractor must coordinate the excavation, obtain an Engineering permit, and have the work inspected. Sewer connection requirements and fees should be confirmed separately.

facts.text: Newton requires a water-service application for a new water service and says the Utilities Division prepares a cost estimate for City labor and materials.
Newton states that the private utility contractor must obtain an Engineering permit and have the work inspected by the Engineering Division.

qa.q: Does the City provide a fixed price for every new water service?
qa.a: No. Newton says the Utilities Division generates a cost estimate for the proposed work after the water-service application is submitted.
